criteria.requirement: A coherent 3D museum gallery presents multiple distinguishable antique artifacts.
criteria.action: Inspect the gallery and identify several exhibits.
criteria.expected: A coherent 3D museum contains multiple distinguishable antique artifacts.

criteria.requirement: The artifacts are genuinely modeled in 3D and can be explored interactively.
criteria.action: Explore different artifacts through their offered interactions.
criteria.expected: Artifacts have inspectable 3D form rather than only static image substitutions.

criteria.requirement: Gallery navigation or selection makes different artifacts reachable and keeps the exhibit context understandable.
criteria.action: Navigate or select several exhibits and return to an earlier one.
criteria.expected: Different artifacts are reachable and the gallery context remains understandable.

criteria.requirement: The immersive presentation preserves readable information and usable interactions.
criteria.action: Inspect artifact information and controls while exploring.
criteria.expected: The immersive presentation keeps content readable and interactions usable.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the gallery and identify multiple artifacts.
Select or navigate to different exhibits and inspect their shapes from the offered interaction.
Return to an earlier exhibit and use another view; do not require a particular historical collection or navigation mechanism.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
